mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 4% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three-month RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals improving manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings expectations and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of three-month INDPRO increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) for two consecutive months signals a successful disinflationary monetary tightening, which reduces long-term interest rates and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND CPIAUCSL falls for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of simultaneous FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL declines for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) for two consecutive months signals accelerating labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises AND PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of simultaneous UNRATE increases and PAYEMS declines for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals improving residential investment, which boosts construction-related earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of three-month HOUST increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three-month RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05).
